_meta.description: Demo seed for BBVProgramme + BudgetBBVMapping covering fiscal year 2026. Five demo programmes (1.1.1, 1.2.1, 2.3.2, 2.4.1, 3.1.0) plus the demo allocation split documented in design.md: GL 4100 (Personnel) → 50% 1.1.1, 30% 1.2.1, 20% 2.4.1; GL 5000 (Operations) → 25% 2.3.2, 75% 2.4.1. Production waterboards configure their own programmes and mappings via the admin UI in chain members 04 + 06/07: this seed exists so dev/demo installs render the dashboard (chain member 05) without empty-state placeholders. Seeding is idempotent: BBVProgramme dedupes on (administrationId, programmeCode, fiscalYear) and BudgetBBVMapping dedupes on (administrationId, glAccountNumber, programmeCode, effectiveFrom).

programmes.description: Core administrative programme covering general administration, board support and shared services.
Human resources, payroll, training and personnel administration across the waterboard.
Surface- and ground-water quality monitoring, sampling and laboratory analysis aligned with the Kaderrichtlijn Water programme.
Asset maintenance and renewal across pumping stations, weirs, sluices and other water-system infrastructure.
Long-range strategic planning, climate-adaptation roadmaps and investment programming.
